question: Does attenuated selected IFN RNA under B3 coexist with an acute Osmr RNA change in the same six deposited colon libraries?
decision: Narrow whether a later epithelial protein and OSM response comparison is motivated; no functional conclusion.
strongest_rival: Broad response attenuation, outcome-selected panels, individual-library variation, bulk composition and unmeasured batches can mimic a selective transcriptional program.
discriminator: Fixed Osmr B3-WT and each versus PBS, three existing scales and six single-library omissions; composition and function remain unresolved.
exposure_record: Both papers and existing genome-wide source outputs were previously exposed. Before this freeze only the Osmr annotation and existing eligibility flag were inspected, not target outcome contrasts. This remains exposed shared-source description.
biological_unit: Deposited RNA library; paper reports two independent biological samples per group, but animal/preparation identity and allocation keys remain unverified.
nesting_and_overlap: Gene rows nest in the same six whole-colon libraries. Fixed sets overlap. Both vehicle-relative axes reuse PBS; omission views and normalization scales reuse the same observations. No gene-based biological replication.
population_and_selection: Exactly one uniquely mapped target Osmr ENSMUSG00000022146; all six libraries; unchanged CPM>=1 in at least two rule.
contrast: WT-PBS, published 22-B3-PBS and direct 22-B3-WT, each as difference of group means of per-library log2(expression+1); these are not fitted population log-fold changes.
endpoint: Osmr per-library abundance and difference of mean log2(expression+1), with observed omission extrema.
methods: See osmr_v1/METHODS.md. Reuse immutable primary CPM and per-view TMM denominators; deposited FPKM; exactly 21 scale/view cases, three contrasts, all six library values.
missingness_and_exclusions: No target replacement, extra receptor, library exclusion, row collapse or altered expression threshold.
multiplicity: One fixed target, three contrasts, three scales, seven views. No p-values, FDR, confidence intervals or equivalence claims.
precision_basis: Finite-library exposed description only. Two source libraries per group do not establish verified population units; six omission ranges describe observed sensitivity, not sampling uncertainty.
interpretation_limit: Osmr RNA is not OSM responsiveness, receptor protein, epithelial localization, protection, chronic risk or independent replication.
stop_rule: Stop affected endpoint on hash/schema mismatch, absent/ambiguous target, invalid expression or changed eligibility. No substitution; preserve failures and old artifacts.
amendment_reason: New literature-motivated fixed Osmr endpoint, not replacement of prior panels or repeated generic scoring. Existing outputs and eligibility are reused unchanged.
